featured_reviews.review_text: It's not a great theater. I visited this place to experience single screen atmosphere. And it was not a great one. featured_reviews.name: Jainam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this to warn everyone about the severe lack of safety and basic humanity at Roxy Cinema. Yesterday, my mother attended the 10 PM show of 'Dhabkaaro'. As the crowd was exiting the lift, a heavy ceiling tile suddenly collapsed and fell onto the people below. Two people were injured badly and bleeding, and heavy tile pieces hit my mother's head.
While accidents can happen, the theatre staff's reaction was absolutely disgusting. They were completely uncooperative. Nobody stepped forward to offer basic first aid, medical support, or even a glass of water to the bleeding and injured patrons. We had to literally shout and threaten to call the police just to get them to act, and even then, they helped completely half-heartedly.
We are now dealing with significant medical expenses, and the theatre management hasn't even had the decency to offer a simple apology. They clearly do not care about the safety or lives of their customers. Avoid this theatre at all costs unless you want to put your life at risk.

featured_reviews.name: Kunal Phadnis
featured_reviews.review_text:

Many visitors praise the sound quality and screen clarity, noting that it provides a decent viewing experience despite being an older venue.
The seating is frequently criticized for being torn, uncomfortable, or poorly maintained, with some reviewers noting a lack of cleanliness in the auditorium.
Management issues are a common theme in complaints, specifically regarding long exit processes, unhelpful staff, and unsanitary restroom conditions.
The food court offers classic cinema snacks like popcorn and samosas, though some guests find the pricing to be high relative to the theater's overall quality.
Overall, it is a suitable choice

featured_reviews.name: Stringzzz
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Metro INOX Cinema, and my overall experience was extremely enjoyable and comfortable. This cinema hall perfectly blends a classic feel with modern movie-watching amenities, making it a great choice for both regular viewers and cinema lovers who appreciate a well-maintained theatre.

The screen and sound quality were excellent. The visuals were sharp, bright, and immersive, which made the movie even more engaging. The sound system was well balanced—loud enough to create impact without being overwhelming. Dialogues were clear, and background music and effects were crisp, enhancing the overall cinematic experience.

The seating arrangement deserves special mention. The seats were comfortable, well-spaced, and offered a clear view of the screen from almost every angle. Legroom was sufficient, allowing for a relaxed experience even during a long movie. The auditorium was clean and well maintained, which added to the comfort level.

The ambience of Metro INOX has a pleasant and premium feel. The lobby area was neat, organized, and not overly crowded. The lighting and interiors give a classy vibe, making the wait time before the show quite comfortable. Entry and exit were well managed, avoiding unnecessary rush or confusion.

Food and beverages were also satisfactory. The snacks counter offered the usual cinema favourites like popcorn, cold drinks, and nachos. While prices are on the higher side—as expected in multiplexes—the quality and freshness were good. The staff at the counter were polite and quick in handling orders, even during peak hours.

Another positive aspect was the staff behavior and overall management. The staff members were helpful, courteous, and ensured smooth operations throughout the show. Ticket checking, seating guidance, and cleanliness were handled efficiently. Restrooms were clean and well maintained, which is an important factor for any public place.

Overall, Metro INOX Cinema provides a reliable, comfortable, and enjoyable movie-watching experience. Whether you’re going for a weekend show with friends, a family outing, or a solo movie break, this place delivers on quality, comfort, and ambience. I would definitely recommend Metro INOX Cinema to anyone looking for a pleasant and hassle-free cinema experience.

featured_reviews.review_text: Metro INOX at Marine Lines is a standout cinema that beautifully blends Art Deco heritage with modern luxury, offering a visual treat before the movie even starts. The viewing experience is top-tier, featuring crisp Laser projection and immersive Dolby Atmos sound, while the Insignia screens provide unmatched comfort with recliner seating and butler service. However, this premium experience comes with South Mumbai pricing for tickets and food, and the biggest drawback is the severe lack of parking, often forcing patrons to use distant pay-and-park slots. Overall, it is a perfect spot for a lavish movie date or a special night out if you arrive by cab, but a logistical headache if you plan to drive.

I had read quite a few negative reviews about this place, but ended up booking a ticket anyway because I didn’t have many other options. To my surprise, the experience turned out to be genuinely pleasant.

The hall is small, but it’s clean and well maintained. Unlike most modern theatres where you enter from the front, this one has an entrance from the back, something that instantly gave me a nostalgic, old-school cinema vibe. The screen may be on the smaller side, but both the picture and sound quality were impressive.

The biggest highlight, though, was the ticket price. At just ₹90 for a 4 PM show, it’s hard to beat the value.

If you miss the charm of how movie halls used to be in the ’90s, this place is definitely worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: Utkarsha Mhadeshwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited PVR Cinemas Phoenix Marketcity Kurla and it turned out to be a fantastic movie experience. It is definitely one of the best places in Mumbai to enjoy a film with friends or family.
The first thing that stands out is the excellent sound quality and screen clarity. The audio system is powerful and immersive, making every scene feel more engaging, especially during action or emotional moments. The picture quality is also very sharp and vibrant, which enhances the overall viewing experience. The theatre is well-maintained, and the seating is comfortable, allowing you to enjoy long movies without any discomfort.
The ambience of the cinema is also very impressive. From the moment you enter, the place feels premium and lively. It is located inside Phoenix Marketcity, so you also get a great mall environment with shopping and entertainment options before or after your movie.
Another major highlight is the variety of food and snacks available. You can choose from popcorn, nachos, burgers, beverages, and more. However, like most multiplexes, the food prices are on the higher side. While the quality is good, you should be prepared to spend a bit extra if you plan to eat there.
In terms of accessibility, the location is very convenient. You can easily reach the cinema by taking an auto rickshaw from Kurla or Vidyavihar railway station, making it a hassle-free destination for moviegoers.
Overall, PVR Cinemas at Phoenix Marketcity Kurla offers a premium and enjoyable movie experience with great sound, visuals, ambience, and accessibility—just keep in mind the slightly expensive food.

featured_reviews.review_text: Watched a movie at PVR Cinemas Phoenix Marketcity and had a great experience. The screens are large with excellent picture and sound quality, making the movie very immersive. Seating is comfortable and well-maintained, providing a good viewing experience. The theater is clean and staff are helpful. Located inside the mall, it’s convenient with plenty of food and shopping options nearby. Ticket prices are slightly on the higher side, but overall it’s a great place to enjoy movies in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Krittika Khandare
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review to document a serious food safety incident at PVR, Jio World Plaza, BKC.

On 15 January 2026, I attended the 6:00 PM show of Avatar 3 in Audi 6. Before the movie, I purchased food from the PVR counter. While eating it during the show, the final bite contained a visible piece of glass that entered my mouth. I immediately spat it out. The fact that I was not physically injured was purely a matter of luck, this could have caused severe internal injury or worse.

I have video evidence clearly showing the glass shard in the food.

What has been equally disturbing is the way this matter has been handled since. Despite multiple emails, follow-ups, and assurances that the issue was being taken seriously, there were significant delays, inconsistent communication, and ultimately a response stating that no lapse could be established at their end. The only gesture initially offered was complimentary movie tickets, which is entirely inappropriate for a life-threatening food safety incident.

As a paying customer, being exposed to such a risk and then experiencing weeks of delay and deflection has been deeply distressing. This review is being posted so that other patrons are aware and so that this concern is documented publicly after private escalation failed to lead to a responsible resolution.

I hope PVR reviews its food safety accountability and customer handling practices more seriously going forward.

The overall ambience and maintenance were excellent.

Ticket pricing between ₹250–₹500 feels reasonable considering the cleanliness and comfort, especially if booked smartly on weekdays.

But as usual with PVR, the food pricing is absurd. Ordered a ₹350 Schezwan Paneer Wrap and it was a complete waste of money. The taste was terrible and definitely not worth the price. They serve it properly with a tray, plate, and cutlery, but realistically, how convenient is that setup inside a movie theatre while watching a film in the dark?

Popcorn and drinks are also heavily overpriced, and the quantity doesn’t justify the cost either.

Overall: great theatre experience for seating, cleanliness, and ambience — but avoid spending too much on the food unless you’re okay paying premium prices for average quality.

featured_reviews.name: Alok Shettigar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Movie Time is just a 10-minute walk from the Dahisar Metro Station, but finding it was a bit of a struggle since there were no signs outside to guide us. Unlike most theatres, there’s no clear entry point, which made things confusing.

The lift situation wasn’t great either—there’s only one, and it barely fits five people, so getting in and out felt like a waiting game. Inside, there’s just one screen, and honestly, the theatre felt more like a small pod. The viewing experience was okay, but the sound quality could have been way better.

Now, let’s talk about the seats—definitely not the most comfortable. Sitting through a long movie was a bit of a task. On the plus side, the food area was clean, but the prices? Almost as high as PVR, which felt a bit much for the overall experience.

One good thing—they have free underground parking for both bikes and cars, which is a rare win in Mumbai!

Overall, if you’re nearby and just want to catch a movie, it works. But if you’re looking for a top-tier cinema experience, this might not be the best pick.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointed with the management. Every time I visit this theatre, I face the same issue regarding my bike helmet. Visitors arriving on two-wheelers are not allowed to carry helmets inside, yet there is no proper and secure facility provided to keep them. Customers are forced to leave their helmets outside at their own risk.

This is an inconvenience and a basic customer service issue that has remained unresolved despite repeated visits. If the theatre does not allow helmets inside, it should provide a safe and organized storage facility for riders.

I request the management to address this issue seriously and implement a proper solution instead of making customers face the same problem every time.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: The screen and audio quality are top-notch, delivering a great cinematic experience. However, the seats in screen 5 need attention they make a lot of noise, which was distracting during the movie.Improving this would make the overall experience much better.

featured_reviews.name: Yeshika Dhandhania
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience at PVR INOX. I requested a blanket and was told by the staff that blankets are only available for recliner seats. When I mentioned that I had received one during a previous visit, the staff simply said that the rules had changed.

What made the situation even more frustrating was that I could clearly see guests seated in front of me who were not in recliner seats but had been given blankets. When I pointed this out, the staff changed their response and told me where I could get one from instead. The inconsistent explanations made it seem like the staff either didn’t know the policy or were unwilling to help.

Customer service should be transparent and consistent. If there is a policy, it should be applied equally to all guests. The entire interaction felt unprofessional and left a negative impression of the cinema experience.

featured_reviews.name: Vimesh Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: The Playhouse screen is a superb experience. Thanks to the PVR team for reimaging cinema going experience. A sea change from regular looking cinema. Ideas like these pulls you back to watching movies in cinema halls. Vibrant colours, seats, floor, the walls are a visualvtrrat. So a perfect place to watch a film with family. This screen will ensure it becomes memorable. Keep it up Team PVR.

featured_reviews.name: aakruti dave
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited PVR ICON and was impressed with the overall experience. The spacious lobby was a welcome sight, allowing for easy movement even during busy times.

Inside the theatre, the seating was very comfortable, with plenty of legroom that made watching the movie more enjoyable. The sound and picture quality were both top-notch, providing an immersive movie experience.

Overall, This cinema offers a great atmosphere, comfortable seating, and excellent sound and viewing quality. I highly recommend it for a quality movie outing.

featured_reviews.name: Falguni P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing movie experience.
I like their seats and sound quality.
The staff is friendly and helpful, but they really need to improve their cleanliness on the counter as I found  cockroaches on the food counter.
The washrooms are well cleaned and they also have diaper changing rooms.
The dedicated screen for kids is the highlight of this pvr, it's called playhouse and usually has animated and kids friendly movies the ambience is made playful and colourful with swings inside.

featured_reviews.name: Kartikeya Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text:
PVR Cinema – Oberoi Mall, Mumbai

I recently visited PVR Cinema at Oberoi Mall, Mumbai, and had a fantastic overall experience. Of course, the cinema itself lives up to the PVR standard – clean, comfortable seating, great sound and picture quality, and a well-maintained ambiance. But what really caught me by surprise this time was the food.

We decided to try the hotdogs, and honestly, they were far better than the typical movie-snack expectations. The buns were perfectly steamed – soft, warm, and fresh – which made a big difference in texture. The sausage was juicy and flavorful, and they nailed the condiment-to-meat ratio. Nothing was overly messy or underwhelming – just a really well-balanced, satisfying bite that felt thoughtfully put together rather than rushed.

Another nice touch was the small Costa Coffee counter inside the cinema area. It’s not a full café, but they do serve the essentials. We ordered an iced latte, and it was surprisingly good – strong but not bitter, with just the right amount of milk and ice. It was a refreshing complement to the hot food and added to the overall premium feel of the experience.

All in all, PVR Oberoi Mall offers more than just movies – it’s clearly putting effort into creating a quality experience across the board, including the food and beverage options. Whether you’re here for a blockbuster or just want a relaxed evening out, this location delivers on multiple fronts. Definitely looking forward to going back.

featured_reviews.name: CS Rahul Taori
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited MovieMax Mira Road, and overall it was a good experience, especially considering its proximity to my residence.
The biggest advantage of this theatre is its location and convenience — very easy to access if you stay nearby, making it a go-to option for quick movie plans without much travel hassle.
Talking about the theatre itself, the seating, screen quality, and sound system are quite decent. It may not be ultra-premium, but it delivers a comfortable and enjoyable movie experience.
One major downside, however, is the food and beverages. The pricing is quite high compared to the quality and quantity offered. Honestly, it doesn’t feel worth the money, and this is something they really need to improve.
On the positive side, ticket prices are affordable, which balances out the experience to some extent and makes it a budget-friendly entertainment option.
Final Verdict:
A convenient and reliable theatre for regular movie outings, but avoid spending much on food inside.
Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5)

customer_updates.text:
Subject: Complaint Regarding Poor Service and Unclean Seats at Miraj Cinemas

Dear Miraj Cinemas Team,

Today, I visited your theatre and was extremely disappointed with the service provided. I had booked 3 seats in advance, choosing the seats as per my preference. However, when I arrived, I found that the seats were not cleaned properly and were in an unacceptable condition.

When I informed the staff about this issue, instead of addressing the problem or cleaning the seats, they simply advised me to change my seats. While they did offer me alternate seats, this was not what I had selected during booking, and it disrupted our planned seating arrangement.

I had paid for a specific experience and expected the seats I selected to be clean and ready. This situation was both frustrating and unprofessional. I request you to look into this matter seriously and ensure that customers receive the service they pay for.
